# Data Import
```{r}
## Functions
fetch_sample_info <- function(sample, var) {
  return(metadata %>% filter(sample_name == sample) %>% pull(var) %>% as.character())
}

snRNA_mat_path <- paste(dir_list$data, "DPSC_snRNAseq_filt_matrices", sep = "/")

snRNA_mat_dir_list <- list.dirs(snRNA_mat_path, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

snRNA_data_list <- list()

snRNA_data_list$mat_data <- list()
snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects <- list()

for (dir in snRNA_mat_dir_list) {

  # Extracting corresponding sample information to add as metadata later
  folder_name_split <- str_split_1(tail(str_split_1(dir, "/"), 1), "_")
  
  sample_name <- paste(folder_name_split[3], folder_name_split[5], sep ="_")
  sample_id <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "sample_id")
  sample_id_new <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "sample_id_new")
  donor <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "donor")
  donor_id <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "donor_id")
  cell_type <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "cell_type")
  age <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "age")
  sex <- fetch_sample_info(sample_name, "sex")
  
  # Creating dgc matrix from raw data and adding them to the raw data list 
  snRNA_data_list$mat_data[[sample_id]] <- Read10X(dir, strip.suffix = TRUE)
  
  colnames(snRNA_data_list$mat_data[[sample_id]]) <- paste(sample_id, 
                                                            colnames(snRNA_data_list$mat_data[[sample_id]]), 
                                                            sep = "-")
  
  # Creating Seurat Object from the dgc matrices
  snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects[[sample_id]] <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = snRNA_data_list$mat_data[[sample_id]],
                                                                   project = "dpsc_iN_snRNAseq",
                                                                   names.field = 1,
                                                                   names.delim = "-")

  # Adding metadata to the Seurat Object
  snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects[[sample_id]]@meta.data  <- snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects[[sample_id]]@meta.data %>%
    mutate("sample_name" = rep(sample_name),
           "sample_id" = rep(sample_id),
           "sample_id_new" = rep(sample_id_new),
           "donor" = rep(donor),
           "donor_id" = rep(donor_id),
           "cell_type" = rep(cell_type),
           "age" = rep(age),
           "sex" = rep(sex))
}

snRNA_data_so <- merge(snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects[[1]], y = snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects[c(2:length(snRNA_data_list$seurat_objects))])

saveRDS(snRNA_data_list, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "snRNA_data_list.rds", sep = "/"))
saveRDS(snRNA_data_so, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "snRNA_data_so.rds", sep = "/"))

rm(snRNA_data_list, sample_name, dir, sample_id, sample_id_new, donor, donor_id, cell_type, age, sex, snRNA_mat_dir_list, snRNA_mat_path)
gc()
```

# Setting seed
```{r}
seed.use <- 12345
set.seed(seed.use)
```


# 1 | QC
## Adding QC parameters to the metadata
```{r}
snRNA_data_so_qc <- snRNA_data_so

snRNA_data_so_qc@meta.data <-  snRNA_data_so_qc@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(percent.mt = PercentageFeatureSet(snRNA_data_so_qc, pattern = "^MT-"),
         percent.rb = PercentageFeatureSet(snRNA_data_so_qc, pattern = "^RP[SL][[:digit:]]|^RPLP[[:digit:]]|^RPSA"),
         log10GenesPerUMI = log10(nFeature_RNA) / log10(nCount_RNA))

saveRDS(snRNA_data_so_qc, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "snRNA_data_so_qc.rds", sep = "/"))
rm(snRNA_data_so)
```

## Visualising QC parameters
### Cell count before QC
```{r}
plot_dir <- paste(dir_list$plots, "snRNA_seq", "QC", sep = "/")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
plot_height <- 8 
plot_width <- 10 

snRNA_data_so_qc@meta.data %>% 
  	ggplot(aes(x=orig.ident, fill=cell_type)) +
    geom_bar() +
  	theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Samples", y = "Cell Count") +
  	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1, size = 8)) +
  	theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
    ggtitle("Number of cells detected per sample - before QC") + 
    NoLegend()

ggsave(filename = paste(plot_dir,
                        paste("01_CellsDetected_PerSample_BeforeQC_Barplot",
                              "png",
                              sep = "."),
                        sep = "/"),
       device = "png",
       dpi = 300,
       limitsize = F,
       height = plot_height,
       width = plot_width)
```

## Filtering
```{r}
snRNA_data_so_filt <- snRNA_data_so_qc %>% 
  subset(nCount_RNA > 3000 & nCount_RNA < 100000 & nFeature_RNA > 1500 & nFeature_RNA < 10000 & percent.mt < 5)

saveRDS(snRNA_data_so_filt, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "snRNA_data_so_filt.rds", sep = "/"))
rm(snRNA_data_so)
```

# 2 | Normalization, Scaling and PCA
## Log-normalisation
```{r}
set.seed(seed.use)
snRNA_data_so_norm_log <- snRNA_data_so_filt %>% 
  NormalizeData(verbose = F) %>% 
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", 
                       nfeatures = 2000, 
                       verbose = F) %>% 
  ScaleData(verbose = F) %>%
  RunPCA(features = VariableFeatures(.),
         seed.use = seed.use,
         verbose = F)
saveRDS(snRNA_data_so_norm_log, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "snRNA_data_so_norm_log.rds", sep = "/"))
```

```{r}
DimPlot(snRNA_data_so_norm_log, reduction = "pca", group.by = "sample_id")
```


## SC Transformation
```{r}
snRNA_data_so_norm_sct <- snRNA_data_so_filt %>% 
  SCTransform(verbose = FALSE) %>% 
  RunPCA(seed.use = seed.use,
         verbose = F)
saveRDS(snRNA_data_so_norm_sct, file = paste(dir_list$rds, "snRNA_data_so_norm_sct.rds", sep = "/"))
```

```{r}
DimPlot(snRNA_data_so_norm_sct, reduction = "pca", group.by = "sample_id")
```

# 3 | Harmony Integration
## Optimal PCA Selector
```{r}
## Optimal Number of PCs Estimate
optimal_num_pc_estimator <- function(seurat_object,
                                     reduction = "pca"){
  
  # Determine percent of variation associated with each PC
  pct <- seurat_object[[reduction]]@stdev / sum(seurat_object[[reduction]]@stdev) * 100
  
  # Calculate cumulative percents for each PC
  cumu <- cumsum(pct)
  
  # Determine which PC exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90% and % variation associated with the PC as less than 5
  co1 <- which(cumu > 90 & pct < 5)[1]
  
  writeLines(sprintf("\nThe PC which exhibits cumulative percent greater than 90 percentage and percentage variation associated with the PC is less than 5:\t%i", co1))
  
  # Determine the difference between variation of PC and subsequent PC
  co2 <- sort(which((pct[1:length(pct) - 1] - pct[2:length(pct)]) > 0.1), decreasing = T)[1] + 1
  
  # last point where change of % of variation is more than 0.1%.
  writeLines(sprintf("\nlast point where change of percentage of variation is more than 0.1 percentage:\t%i", co2))
  
  # Minimum of the two calculation
  pcs <- min(co1, co2)
  
 writeLines(sprintf("\nThe optimal PC, being the minimum of the two determined:\t%i", pcs))
  
  return(pcs)
}
```

## On Log-normalisation
```{r}
snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int <- IntegrateLayers(object = snRNA_data_so_norm_log, 
                                              method = HarmonyIntegration,
                                              orig.reduction = "pca",
                                              new.reduction = "harmony", 
                                              verbose = FALSE,
                                              harmony.params = list(group.by.vars = "donor_id", seed.use = seed.use))
snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int[["harmony"]]@stdev <- apply(Embeddings(snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int, "harmony"), 2, sd)
```

```

ElbowPlot(snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int, ndims = 50, reduction = "harmony") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal_num_pc_estimator(snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int, reduction = "harmony"), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1)
```

# 4 | Clustering

## Silhouette Analyzer Function
```{r}
silhouette_analyzer <- function(seurat_object,
                                assay,
                                reduction,
                                nPCs = 20,
                                res.diff = 0.1) {
  
  distance_matrix <- dist(Embeddings(seurat_object[[reduction]])[, 1:nPCs])
  
  res <- seq(from = 0.1,
             to = 3.0,
             by = res.diff)
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  col_string <- "snn_res"
  if(identical(tolower(assay),
               "sct")) {
    col_string <- paste("SCT",
                        col_string,
                        sep = "_")
  }
  else {
    col_string <- paste("RNA",
                        col_string,
                        sep = "_")
  }
  
  seurat_object <- seurat_object %>% 
    FindNeighbors(dims = 1:nPCs,
                  verbose = F) %>% 
    FindClusters(resolution = res,
                 verbose = F)
  
  for (col_name in grep(paste(col_string,
                              ".",
                              sep = ""),
                        names(seurat_object@meta.data),
                        value = T)) {
    
    clusters <- seurat_object@meta.data[[col_name]]
    
    silhouette <- cluster::silhouette(as.numeric(clusters),
                             dist = distance_matrix)
    
    mean_silhouette_score <- mean(silhouette[, 3])
    
    results <- rbind(results,
                     data.frame("resolution" = gsub(paste(col_string,
                                                          "[.]*",
                                                          sep = ""),
                                                    "",
                                                    col_name),
                                "mean_sil_score" = mean_silhouette_score))
    
  }
  
  writeLines(sprintf("\nnPCs: %i\tBest Resolution: %s\tSilhouette Score: %f\n",
                     nPCs,
                     results[which.max(results$mean_sil_score),
                             "resolution"],
                     results[which.max(results$mean_sil_score),
                             "mean_sil_score"]))
  
  return(results)
}
```

## On Log-normalisation
```{r}
silhouette_analyzer(snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int, assay = "RNA", reduction = "harmony", nPCs = 22)
```

```{r}
set.seed(seed.use)
snRNA_data_so_norm_log_clust <- snRNA_data_so_norm_log_int %>% 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:22) %>% 
  FindClusters(random.seed = seed.use, resolution = 0.1, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters") %>% 
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:22, reduction.name = "umap.harmony", seed.use = seed.use)
```

```{r}
snRNA_data_so_norm_log_clust <- CellCycleScoring(snRNA_data_so_norm_log_clust, s.features = cc.genes$s.genes, g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes, seed = seed.use)
```
